extensionDescription.message: Never waste time wordsmithing your replies. Just say what you mean, and let AI help turn it into a respectful draft before you send.

optionsLede.message: Choose an LLM provider. The extension calls the selected provider directly after you click the Simple Words button.

writingInstructionsLead.message: Teach Simple Words enough about you to make replies feel natural. The full system prompt is there when you need precise control.
